_comment: The Sunken Vault of Mareth Dunn - a 15-room demo crawl for the multi-LLM D&D system. Each room is tagged in its description with the player capability it is designed to exercise: COMBAT, NEGOTIATION, PUZZLE, TEAMWORK, EXPLORATION, STEALTH, RESOURCE-MANAGEMENT, MORAL-CHOICE. Two pre-built player characters. Connections are authored bidirectionally so the graph is fully traversable.
_goals_comment: Party objectives, in order. Render-time config only (never events). target_location is where the per-turn navigation hint steers; requires_item_held gates activation (the escape route stays hidden until someone holds the Heartstone); complete_when (location_reached | item_held) retires a goal so the next becomes active.

party_goals.text: Descend through the dungeon to reach the Heart Vault, deep below.
Take the Heartstone from the Vault before the seal closes you in.
Escape with the Heartstone by climbing back to the surface.

locations.name: The Collapsed Gatehouse
locations.description: A ruined entry chamber open to a grey sky. Roots have split the flagstones and a toppled statue of a robed figure points one broken arm toward a stairwell descending into the dark. A weathered bronze plaque is bolted to the wall. A short climb up the rubble leads to the surface. [DEMO: EXPLORATION - safe starting room, encourages players to inspect surroundings and read lore before descending.]

locations.name: The Surface
locations.description: A wind-swept hillside above the vault. Grey clouds scud overhead and the ruined gatehouse sinks back into the slope behind you. From here the road runs back to safer country.

locations.name: Antechamber of Names
locations.description: A long hall lined with empty alcoves. Dust lies thick except for one set of fresh bootprints leading deeper in. The air smells of old iron. Three corridors branch from the far end. [DEMO: EXPLORATION + decision-making - first branching point, players must choose a path and ideally coordinate who scouts what.]

locations.name: The Old Guardroom
locations.description: Rusted weapon racks and a cold hearth. Two skeletal sentries in corroded mail jerk upright the moment a living foot crosses the threshold, raising notched blades. [DEMO: COMBAT - a baseline two-enemy fight to verify initiative, attack rolls, and a player going down/being revived.]

locations.name: Forgotten Armory
locations.description: Beyond the guardroom, a small armory the dead never looted. A locked iron strongbox sits on a bench; a healer's kit and a finely balanced longsword rest in plain sight. [DEMO: RESOURCE-MANAGEMENT - reward room; players decide how to divide loot and whether to spend time forcing the strongbox.]

locations.name: The Warded Door
locations.description: A massive door of black stone, its surface carved with a single line of script: 'I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?' A shallow keyhole shaped like an open palm sits beneath the words. [DEMO: PUZZLE - language reasoning. The door opens to whoever speaks the answer ('an echo') aloud as an action. No key exists.]

locations.name: The Echo Gallery
locations.description: A vaulted gallery where every footstep returns threefold. A mournful voice carries from the dark ahead, repeating a plea for help. It may be a trapped prisoner. It may be bait. [DEMO: STEALTH + judgement - players can move quietly to scout, or rush in; rewards information-gathering before commitment.]

locations.name: The Damp Cell
locations.description: An iron cage holds a gaunt man in a tax-collector's chain of office. He claims to be Aldous Finch, wrongly imprisoned, and begs release - he knows the vault's safe path. His story has gaps. [DEMO: NEGOTIATION + MORAL-CHOICE - players must interrogate an NPC with a hidden agenda, weigh trust, and decide whether to free him.]

locations.name: The Flooded Passage
locations.description: Black water fills this corridor chest-deep and rising. A current tugs toward a submerged archway. Crossing demands the party move together - one slip and the current takes the weak. [DEMO: TEAMWORK - a coordination challenge where both characters must act in concert (e.g. one braces, one crosses) rather than solo.]

locations.name: The Sunken Crossroads
locations.description: A wide circular hub where every path of the vault seems to meet. A dry fountain at the center is carved with four basins, each a different symbol: flame, root, tide, bone. The basins are empty. [DEMO: PUZZLE + EXPLORATION - a multi-part puzzle hub that ties the wings together; central to the map's connectivity.]

locations.name: Shrine of the Quiet God
locations.description: A serene chamber with an altar bearing a basin of clear water and an unlit brazier. A presence here will fully restore one who kneels and offers a true confession aloud - but only once per supplicant. [DEMO: RESOURCE-MANAGEMENT + roleplay - a limited healing resource that requires genuine in-character speech to trigger.]

locations.name: The Collapsed Mine Shaft
locations.description: Old vault excavation, now a maze of unstable timber and a deep chasm spanned by a single fraying rope bridge. A glittering vein of silver ore is visible on the far ledge. [DEMO: TEAMWORK + RESOURCE-MANAGEMENT - a hazard crossing with optional risky reward; tests whether players manage risk jointly.]

locations.name: The Silver Ledge
locations.description: A narrow ledge across the chasm holding a rich silver vein and the picked-clean bones of a previous expedition - and their still-usable rope and lantern. [DEMO: EXPLORATION reward + RESOURCE-MANAGEMENT - dead-end payoff for taking the bridge risk.]

locations.name: Hessa's Lantern Nook
locations.description: Improbably, a tiny shop. Hessa, a soot-stained gnome with a crossbow across her lap, trades with anyone who reaches her: potions, rope, a cryptic map fragment - for coin, ore, or information about what stirs below. She does not give credit. [DEMO: NEGOTIATION - a transactional NPC who bargains; tests offer/counter-offer and using non-coin currency.]

locations.name: Hall of the Bound Warden
locations.description: A great hall of fluted columns. At its end, chained to a throne of fused armor, sits the Bound Warden - an ancient revenant that guards the vault's heart. It will speak before it fights, offering a bargain that is not what it seems. The sealed inner vault lies beyond. [DEMO: NEGOTIATION-then-COMBAT boss - tests escalation: a parley that can avert, alter, or trigger a hard fight.]

locations.name: The Heart Vault
locations.description: A small, silent room. On a plain pedestal rests the Heartstone of Mareth Dunn - the objective. Taking it is trivial; the door behind seals on a slow count once it leaves the pedestal. [DEMO: MORAL-CHOICE + TEAMWORK climax - the objective is easy to grab but the escape demands the party act together under pressure.]

attributes.persona: A blunt, loyal half-orc mercenary. Solves problems with force first but is fiercely protective of allies. Speaks plainly.
A quick-witted halfling scout and negotiator. Prefers talking, sneaking, and clever angles over open fights. Curious to a fault.

attributes.tactics: Attacks the nearest living target on sight. Mindless; no morale, fights to destruction.
goals: Attack any living creature you can see in this room.
Do not pursue beyond the guardroom — your duty ends at its threshold.
Fight to destruction; you feel no fear and take no morale.

attributes.tactics: Attacks the nearest living target on sight. Mindless; no morale, fights to destruction.
goals: Attack any living creature you can see in this room.
Do not pursue beyond the guardroom — your duty ends at its threshold.
Fight to destruction; you feel no fear and take no morale.

attributes.secret: Not a wronged tax-collector. He is a thief who triggered the vault's seal and was caged by the Warden. He genuinely knows a safe path but will lead the party into the Echo Gallery's danger to cover his own escape if freed without conditions.
attributes.negotiation_levers: Responds to compassion, to being caught in a lie (Sylvi-style insight), or to a binding promise. Will reveal the true path if pressed on the inconsistencies in his story.
attributes.persona: Desperate, smooth-talking, evasive when questioned about specifics.
goals: Convince the adventurers to free you from this cell.
Pose as a wronged tax-collector who happens to know the safe path to the Vault — this is a lie.
If pressed on inconsistencies in your story, deflect with new fabricated specifics; only admit the lie if caught dead to rights by a successful insight check or repeated cross-examination.
If freed without a binding condition, plan to lead the party into the Echo Gallery so the Lurker buys you a window to escape on your own.

attributes.shop_stock: Potion of healing (2d4+2 hp) for 50 coin; 50ft rope for 5 coin; cryptic map fragment for 30 coin.
attributes.negotiation_levers: Fixed prices for now (haggling not yet supported). Turns hostile only if robbed or threatened.
attributes.persona: Dry, shrewd, unsentimental but fair. Has seen many parties come and not return.
goals: Remain in the merchant nook — do not pursue or wander.
Offer trades from your shop stock to any party that approaches.
Haggle within roughly 30% of asking price; accept information about the Warden as partial payment.
Become hostile only if the party robs or directly threatens you.

attributes.movement_restricted: bound by chains to the throne
attributes.persona: An ancient revenant. Speaks in cold formal sentences. Resents being chained but considers its duty absolute.
attributes.tactics: Opens with a parley: offers to let one person pass if they leave the other behind as a replacement guardian. Fights only if attacked, if the bargain is refused after being heard, or if the Heartstone is taken. Focuses the most heavily armored target. Bound by chains - cannot leave the hall.
attributes.negotiation_levers: Can be reasoned out of the fight entirely if the party offers a genuine alternative binding (a true name, an oath, the freed Aldous as a substitute). A purely combative party gets the full fight.
goals: Defend the inner vault entrance from intruders — this is your sacred binding duty.
Open every first encounter with a parley: offer to let one person pass if the other stays as a replacement guardian.
Fight only if attacked, if the bargain is refused after being heard, or if the Heartstone is taken from the vault.
In combat, focus the most heavily armored target first.
Remain in the warden hall — your chains forbid pursuit.

attributes.tactics: Mimics a human cry for help to lure prey. Hides until a target is within reach or a light reveals it. Surprised targets do not act in the first round. Flees at one quarter HP. Can be avoided entirely by a stealthy or perceptive party.
attributes.negotiation_levers: Not intelligent enough to bargain, but can be scared off by a strong show of force or fire.
goals: Mimic a human cry for help to lure prey deeper into the Echo Gallery.
Stay hidden in the shadows until a target is within striking distance or a light reveals you.
Attack any living creature you can ambush; surprise gives them no first action.
Flee deeper into the gallery if your hp drops below one-quarter.
Retreat in the face of overwhelming force or open fire.

properties.description: An old iron padlock on Aldous Finch's cage. The mechanism is rusted but intact — picking it would free him without requiring his cooperation.

properties.text: Here lies the Vault of Mareth Dunn, sealed against thieves. The Heart must never leave. The Warden keeps the count. Speak truly within and the Quiet God forgives.

A scrawled diagram: the four basins of the Crossroads must be filled - flame from the Shrine brazier, tide from the Flooded Passage, bone from the Warden's hall, root from the Mine - to reveal the Heart's true count of escape.
